summary: Safehold Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a note purchase agreement for a private placement of $225 million aggregate principal amount of 6.615% Senior Notes due 2056. The notes have a stairstep coupon starting at 4.00% cash interest, increasing over time, with accrued interest payable in kind or cash. The offering is a routine debt financing with no special-situation characteristics. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special event is involved.
